enchantments.tooltip: Stormreaver's Thunderclap: This item crackles with power, flickers of lightning emenating from it. On a Melee strike of a Natural 20 that is confirmed as a critical hit, this item will strike your foe with a tremendous burst of lightning. A DC 100 Reflex save will prevent half of this damage.
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Parrying +6: +6 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +6 Insight bonus to Saves.
Doublestrike 15%: Passive: 15% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)

Legendary Arcsteel Battlemage: 3 Pieces Equipped:+30 Artifact bonus to Electric, Fire, Force, and Repair Spell Power+6% Artifact bonus to Electric, Fire, Force, and Repair Spell Crit Chance+3 Artifact bonus to Intelligence+3 Artifact bonus to Spell DCs
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
